ack.startup: request0 ready ACK only after Population open and actual loaded zone2 or4, not merely process launch; current ordinary status session is binding

ack.terminal: Reserved request0/op0/barrier65535/result1 AFTER orderly native FinishTeardown, Store drop/unlocks and native buffer drain, then durable cumulative shard and ACK. Stack accepts only after actual code0/orderly group-empty reap and original run/process/session binding, exact shard hash and immutable cumulative prefix. Startup stays request0/op0/barrier0/result0. Expected fault kill uses live flush only. Any terminal export/ACK failure or unseen sequence gap is nonpass independent of cleanup. Terminal export adds no gameplay command or synthetic release.

barrier.flush: op0 exports cumulative immutable prefix and any existing snapshots, does not clear recorder or force persistence
barrier.snapshot: op1 reads actors-v3/actor-1.json through actor-3.json twice in ascending actor order without locks; same exact bytes, validated schema/revision/owner_epoch in both passes required; otherwise busy. No cached status substitute. Raw sum<=8192; exact snapshot keys are long v2 keys
barrier.global_snapshot_sequence: controller barrier labels1..12 for op1; use barrier as snapshot sequence, globally unique across all shards; no extra snapshot on replay
barrier.intentional_kill: flush records an observed prefix only. Stack binds ACK/hash/last_seq and actual process start+reap. No claim of native release or absence of activity after ACK; unexplained gap inside prefix invalidates.
